''See also: [[Heart of Twin Stars Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Heart of [[Twin Stars]] is a [[technique]] manual that serves as the foundation for the [[Path of Twin Stars]]. The core concept of the method involves dividing a practitioner's spiritual core into two distinct parts, which manifest as two separate balls of light within the [[spirit]]. This dual-core structure provides a significant defensive advantage, as one core can remain functional even if the other is disabled. Beyond defense, the [[technique]] allows a user to separate and manage different types of [[madra]] within a single body. This capability enables the practitioner to hold two different [[Paths]] simultaneously, such as maintaining their own [[pure madra]] while learning a second [[Path]]. The [[technique]] is also used for sorting and filtering various energies, such as those absorbed through consumption or drained from others. By [[cycling]] the Heart of [[Twin Stars]], a user can break down complex influxes of power into their individual components and distribute them to specific areas, including the cores or the physical body. While the [[technique]] requires intense focus and can be difficult to master—especially when processing large or conflicting amounts of energy—it is a central component for those following the [[Path of Twin Stars]]. The manual itself has evolved from a simple instructional guide into a personal record for documenting the development of this unique [[Path]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Heart of [[Twin Stars]] is a [[spirit]] [[Enforcer technique]] capable of splitting a single core into two or separating a portion of the soul from itself. During his journey, [[Lindon]] utilizes a modified version of this [[technique]] that can be empowered by [[Little Blue]]. While draining power from a priest, [[Lindon]] successfully cycled the [[technique]]. Now residing within him, the Heart of [[Twin Stars]] is used by [[Lindon]] to sort energy.}}
